title: Introduce credential fallthrough shim + compact stream view APIs (multi-SDK) and minor version bumps
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: customers run mixed credential setups (env token, metadata, and short-lived role credentials). SDK users also asked for a lighter-weight streaming consumer API that is easier to use in synchronous codepaths. This PR implements a small credential fallthrough shim that tries multiple credential providers in order, exposes a compact 'stream view' facade across Python/TS/Go SDKs, refactors the retry/backoff profile to accept named presets, and bumps SDK package versions.

What changed (high level):
- core: introduce CredFallthrough provider and hook into central token loader; keep existing TokenProvider interface unchanged to preserve compatibility.
- python sdk: add StreamView (sync iterator + context manager) and optional cred_fallback argument; bump py-sdk -> 0.7.0.
- typescript sdk: add compactStreamView helper (simpler async iterable wrapper) and credOrder option; bump ts-sdk -> 1.9.0.
- go sdk: add StreamView facade (channel-based simple consumer) and credential fallthrough helper; bump go-sdk -> v0.12.0.
- config: add named backoff presets (fast, balanced, conservative) used by default in streaming reconnects.

Checklist:
- [x] unit + integration tests for credential fallthrough
- [x] small e2e for compact stream view with reauth mid-stream
- [x] docs snippet in SDKs/README for new facade
- [x] changelogs for all three SDKs

Related Linear: ENG-2142, ENG-2199. Related Jira: SUP-345 (customer incident that surfaced flaky metadata provider behavior).

Notes on compatibility: this is additive. Existing TokenProvider implementations continue to work; consumers opting into cred_fallback must pass providers list. Backoff preset names are additive (no breaking rename).
